items: ✓ open a story — You’ll never believe what happened…
✓ set the scene, then move to the events recycled — I was having lunch when a man came over
✓ move a story on and close it — So, anyway… In the end…
✓ say how you felt — I was so embarrassed! I was really scared!
✓ react to someone else’s story — Oh no! You’re joking! What a nightmare!
✓ ask for the next part — So then what happened?
